findings.body: 711 (144 Lndufklu apnlndfn mjcfkluojl cfjmkluojl in yljikcn), 7015.01 (Vcuzvbmz hzu stuxtmct rmohbfceom azuzvc 2413.41), 1012.01 (Nnsefni mkxmwzem dnzmnf 2420.42): return on equity in Dec 2024 — 1.3%; return on equity in Dec 2025 — 31.5%. Basis: the same company's Dec 2025 (period period-agras-dec2025) against Dec 2024 (period period-carniprod-dec2024), both graded on the general_sme_fallback band table (sha256 5fd90c0ea1cc) under one credit model revision. Source: period period-agras-dec2025; accounts 711, 7015.01, 1012.01; assembled_canonical_v1; vs period period-carniprod-dec2024. Rule band_roe fires when strong rung of return on equity is at or above 20.0%; observed 31.5%. Impact: the numerator of return on equity at the strong rung, versus as held moves from RON 4,784,817 to RON 7,533,676. For a mid-size inventory-heavy operator, return on equity on 711 / 7015.01 / 1012.01 is the earnings line everything else is sized from by the group treasury and the statutory auditor, so a change of band year on year moves the valuation and the credit view together. Do this: 1) Reconcile the return on equity movement from Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 to the ledger — two-period balance listing for accounts 711, 7015.01, 1012.01, from the financial controller (before the next board pack). 2) Confirm the move past the strong rung comes from recurring trading, not a single posting — list of non-recurring entries on accounts 711, 7015.01, 1012.01 in Dec 2025, from the financial controller. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations built from a single period's balances; working-capital movements carry a wide band. Both periods are graded on the current band table and credit model revision (restated comparatives), a convention rather than the bands in force when the earlier period was filed. (profile inventory_operator/band_mid/fin_related_party_funded resolved from structure).

findings.body: 5191.01 (Txkxs zs bfszxi Tsx SUS 2070.30 2070.30), 167.401 (Phfdrct cmcexz-fozm 457.364 457.364), 711 (144 Lndufklu apnlndfn mjcfkluojl cfjmkluojl in yljikcn): net debt to EBITDA in Dec 2024 — 11.81×; net debt to EBITDA in Dec 2025 — 0.21×. Basis: the same company's Dec 2025 (period period-agras-dec2025) against Dec 2024 (period period-retail-dec2024), both graded on the general_sme_fallback band table (sha256 5fd90c0ea1cc) under one credit model revision. Source: period period-agras-dec2025; accounts 5191.01, 167.401, 711; assembled_canonical_v1; vs period period-retail-dec2024. Rule band_net_debt_to_ebitda fires when strong rung of net debt to EBITDA is at or below 1.50×; observed 0.21×. Impact: the numerator of net debt to EBITDA at the strong rung, versus as held moves from RON 17,772,098 to RON 2,472,691. A mid-size inventory-heavy operator is underwritten by the group treasury and the statutory auditor on the debt it carries against what it earns and owns; net debt to EBITDA on 5191.01 / 167.401 / 711 moving band between the two periods changes that answer. Do this: 1) Reconcile the net debt to EBITDA movement from Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 to the ledger — two-period balance listing for accounts 5191.01, 167.401, 711, from the financial controller (before the next board pack). 2) Confirm the move past the strong rung comes from recurring trading, not a single posting — list of non-recurring entries on accounts 5191.01, 167.401, 711 in Dec 2025, from the financial controller. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations built from a single period's balances; working-capital movements carry a wide band. Both periods are graded on the current band table and credit model revision (restated comparatives), a convention rather than the bands in force when the earlier period was filed. (profile inventory_operator/band_mid/fin_related_party_funded resolved from structure).

Confidence medium — The account mix did not resolve to a structural profile, so this threshold is the cross-profile default rather than a tuned one. Both periods are graded on the current band table and credit model revision (restated comparatives), a convention rather than the bands in force when the earlier period was filed. findings.body: 331001 (Mndh.so qinc hu uguqilsu), 371901 (Kwqipqb ax zwc.btyjbebl.), 455102 (Otzcmhfpc tmhz.tgpahz Ibn): credit composite in Dec 2024 — 79.3; credit composite in Dec 2025 — 41.5. Basis: the same company's Dec 2025 (period period-realestate-dec2025) against Dec 2024 (period period-carniprod-dec2024), both graded on the credit model's letter ladder (CREDIT_LETTER_LADDER) under credit model revision 3. Source: period period-realestate-dec2025; accounts 331001, 371901, 455102; assembled_canonical_v1; vs period period-carniprod-dec2024. Rule band_letter_grade fires when BB rung of credit composite is below 50.0; observed 41.5. Source: period period-retail-dec2025; accounts 1621.02, 1621.81, 1171.00; assembled_canonical_v1; vs period period-realestate-dec2024. Rule band_lt_debt_to_equity fires when healthy rung of long-term debt to equity is above 0.60×; observed 1.10×. Impact: the numerator of long-term debt to equity at the healthy rung, versus as held moves from RON 15,134,506 to RON 27,860,103. A mid-size operator (structure not inferable) is underwritten by the lending bank's credit committee on the debt it carries against what it earns and owns; long-term debt to equity on 1621.02 / 1621.81 / 1171.00 moving band between the two periods changes that answer. Do this: 1) Reconcile the long-term debt to equity movement from Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 to the ledger — two-period balance listing for accounts 1621.02, 1621.81, 1171.00, from the financial controller (before the next board pack). 2) Quantify what returns long-term debt to equity to the healthy rung — headroom schedule for the numerator and the denominator of long-term debt to equity, from the FP&A team. Confidence medium — The account mix did not resolve to a structural profile, so this threshold is the cross-profile default rather than a tuned one. Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations built from a single period's balances; working-capital movements carry a wide band. Both periods are graded on the current band table and credit model revision (restated comparatives), a convention rather than the bands in force when the earlier period was filed.
